blockingFinding.title: P3 gate validates presence but not executor-stage compatibility
blockingFinding.whyItBlocksAcceptance: P3 requires executor tools to consume the planSelection for the run they are about to execute. alembic_bootstrap is the coldStart executor, while alembic_rescan is the deepMining/moduleMining executor. The current implementation derives generationStage from planSelection before comparing it, so a mismatched planSelection changes the tool stage instead of being rejected at the gate entry.
blockingFinding.rawProbeCommand: node --input-type=module <<'NODE' ... import dist plan-generation-gate and mcp-tools; safeParse and resolvePlanGenerationGate for bootstrap+deepMining and rescan+coldStart ... NODE
sourceFacts: AlembicPlugin/lib/recipe-generation/plan-generation-gate.ts line 106-108 sets generationStage = input.planSelection.generationStage ?? input.generationStage ?? defaultStage.
Because validatePlanSelection receives that already-overridden generationStage, the mismatch branch at line 145 cannot catch a bootstrap deepMining selection or rescan coldStart selection.
AlembicPlugin/lib/shared/schemas/mcp-tools.ts PlanSelectionInput allows all three stages and BootstrapInput/RescanInput reuse it without stage-specific narrowing.
requiredRepair: Make bootstrap reject planSelection.generationStage other than coldStart.
Make rescan reject planSelection.generationStage coldStart; allow only deepMining or moduleMining.
Make resolvePlanGenerationGate compare planSelection.generationStage against the executor/requested/default stage instead of allowing planSelection to override the executor stage.
Add regression tests for bootstrap+deepMining and rescan+coldStart mismatches at both schema or gate level as appropriate.
Keep P4 checkpoint/SOP/missionBriefing and P5 BiliDili e2e untouched.

residualRisks: P4 checkpoint HEAD rewire and SOP/missionBriefing derivation are still future phases.
P5 real-project e2e is still future phase.
controllerConclusion: Request rework for P3. The implementation handles missing planSelection and forwarding, but does not yet enforce that the planSelection belongs to the executor's stage.
